name: Dartmouth AI Club
tagline: Undergraduates who study and build AI.
description: Dartmouth undergraduates studying and building AI: weekly meetings on a paper or a topic, and talks with the people building AI.

join.note: The club's page on Dartmouth Groups, which takes a Dartmouth login: people join there, members get the GroupMe link there, and each meeting's time and room are posted there.
